rationale: SMB website owners routinely lose revenue from unindexed service pages, and the pain of manually cross-referencing Search Console, sitemaps, robots.txt, and canonical tags is well-documented across forums. Competitor tools (Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush) charge $50–$200/month but are widely cited as too complex for non-technical buyers—a clear pricing and UX gap. At least five distinct recurring complaint patterns exist in public threads, and the paid audit category confirms willingness to pay.
